tasks.title: Sag under load
tasks.solution: ΔU = I·R_pack = I·S·R_cell. From the sag at a known current you get R, the main indicator of cell health.

tasks.title: Energy and mass
tasks.solution: E = S·P·Q·U_nom. Parallel multiplies the capacity, series multiplies the voltage.
